description: Search the CanonCannon episode corpus — 10,000+ podcast episodes with the ideas, guests and books extracted from each. Filter by show, by publication date, or by free text. Requires a CanonCannon API key via _apiKey. Example: canon_episode_search({ query: "sleep apnea", since: "2026-01-01" }).

_apiKey.description: CanonCannon API key (cc_live_...). Every /api/v1 endpoint refuses without it. Keys are issued by CanonCannon — https://canoncannon.com

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous call's next_cursor.

query.description: Free-text search over episode titles and extracted content.

since.description: Only episodes published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: canon_episode_search
title: Canon Episode Search
